howto.name: Upload GIF images
howto.text: Drop one or many .gif files. Animated GIFs use only the first frame.

howto.name: Choose page size
howto.text: Letter or A4. Each GIF scales to fit while preserving aspect ratio.

howto.name: Download the PDF
howto.text: All GIFs are combined into one PDF, one image per page in upload order.

faq.q: Do animated GIFs animate inside the PDF?
faq.a: No — PDF doesn't support animation. Only the first frame is used. To convert animation to PDF, use GIF to MP4 then Video to PDF for keyframes.
GIF transparent pixels render against a white page background. Use PNG-to-PDF if you need true alpha.

faq.q: Can the GIF stay as a GIF inside the PDF?
faq.a: PDF doesn't natively support GIF — the image is re-encoded as JPEG or Flate during embedding.
